## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to governance frameworks, decision-making processes, policy management, and organizational oversight to ensure consistent governance across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/governance/README.md#examples-of-governance-standards]

## Examples of Governance Standards

- Architecture governance and review standards for design oversight processes
- Decision-making authority and escalation procedures for clear accountability
- Policy development and maintenance standards for consistent policy management
- Risk management and assessment frameworks for enterprise risk oversight
- Compliance monitoring and reporting standards for regulatory adherence
- Stakeholder engagement and communication standards for effective collaboration
- Resource allocation and budget management procedures for financial governance
- Performance measurement and improvement standards for continuous enhancement
- Change management governance standards for organizational transformation
- Strategic planning and portfolio management standards for investment decisions
